This is a real, external judge-availability constraint hit while building this report, not a defect in RAGeval or in this script -- relevance, faithfulness, cost and persona-scope-violation detection all still work independently of the judge panel (see `results`) and are reported honestly rather than masked. See `multi_judge_consensus_proof_of_mechanism` below for evidence the consensus mechanism itself works correctly when judges are reachable.
